observed: A built multi-storey mural facade with a large numeral 6.
Ground-floor shops, planters, outdoor tables and a broad hard-paved foreground are visible.
The source watermark and same-post route context identify the image as FICS/Xinhua 365.
The drawing places Xinhua 365 south of Xinhua Road and west of the Lane 345 community center.
It records an ordered citywalk context but no campus outline or internal-road geometry.
A visible FICS 365 rooftop sign and a facade numeral 9 identify the same compound.
A narrow open-air hard-surfaced passage runs between built facades.
The captured segment includes exposed fire-service pipes, a convex mirror, vegetation, a transverse threshold or speed bump and steps at the far end.
notObserved: proof that the passage is OSM way/577252268
proof that either facade is OSM way/864493177
formal access class, complete cover status or road edge coordinates

observed: Two previously unregistered same-post real photos show built FICS scenes labelled by visible numerals 6 and 9.
The numeral-9 scene contains an open-air hard-surfaced internal passage between buildings.
A same-post hand-drawn route map places Xinhua 365 approximately south of Xinhua Road and west of the Lane 345 community center.
All three immutable dynamic-evidence snapshots pass their complete SHA256SUMS verification.
The prior six FICS references and all runtime/MCP captures found by filename are duplicates of already known material.

inferred.claim: The photo set improves identity and internal-space coverage by showing at least two numbered FICS scenes and one service-like passage.
The numeral-9 passage may be an internal service or pedestrian alley, but it cannot be equated with OSM way/577252268 without a geolocatable control chain.
The hand-drawn route map supports approximate entrance-side context, not a calibrated entrance point or continuous route.

unknown: Whether numerals 6 and 9 are formal building numbers, zone labels or commercial wayfinding.
Which, if any, of the five candidate ways correspond to the photographed numeral-6 and numeral-9 facades.
Whether the photographed passage is way/577252268.
The real width, mapped edge, exact surface specification, access status and full covered/layer disposition of way/577252268.
The continuous path from the Xinhua Road/Lane 365 entrance to the photographed internal passage.
The formal campus boundary and complete member table.

acceptanceEvaluation.effect: Visible numerals 6 and 9 are new identity controls but not a formal member schedule or boundary.
No photo, frame or manifest contains a geolocatable photo-to-way correspondence.
The numeral-9 passage is real and open-air in the captured segment, but neither adjacent facade is bound to way/864493177.
An unknown internal passage is visibly hard-surfaced and uncovered in-frame; width, access, complete cover and OSM identity remain unknown.
The hand-drawn route gives approximate neighborhood order only; no continuous exterior-to-interior sequence exists.
No north arrow, scale, survey control, orthophoto or reproducible campus outline was found.

verdict.mainWindowAction: Integrate this additive offline evidence audit, preserve all source files in place, and keep the browser/XHS reasonable-search gate pending. The hidden photos improve identity and generic internal-lane evidence but do not authorize map, road, collision, Hero/Identity or runtime changes.
